topic: Automating savings vs relying on willpower (Jay vs Robin)

scenes.narration: Automating savings saves three times more than willpower. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two trophies, one labeled AUTO and one labeled WILLPOWER, comic burst banner reads THREE TIMES MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jay and Robin both want to save four hundred dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man jay and woman robin in workout gear each holding paycheck slips with goal notes reading FOUR HUNDRED PER MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both are aiming to build a future house down payment fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both jay and robin holding tiny house photos with target arrows pointing to a savings vault, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jay plans to manually transfer on the last day of every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, jay at a laptop on the last day of the month checking a bank balance, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He waits to see what is left in checking each month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, jay holding up his phone showing a checking balance near zero, comic banner reads NOTHING LEFT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Robin sets an automatic transfer for the day after every payday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, robin at a phone screen tapping AUTO TRANSFER FOUR HUNDRED, calendar with two paydays circled, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The four hundred disappears into savings before she even sees it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an arrow pulling FOUR HUNDRED out of robin's checking into a savings vault automatically, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two years later Jay transferred only nine hundred dollars total.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked jay at a kitchen table looking at a savings balance reading NINE HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Something always came up in checking before month end.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, jay with a list of impulse purchases like DINNER OUT, NEW SHOES, CONCERT TICKETS draining his account, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Robin's automation moved nine thousand six hundred dollars to her fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, robin holding a savings app reading NINE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED in big green numbers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same goal, same paycheck, ten times the actual result.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side jay with thin savings, right side robin with a tall savings stack, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Automate savings the day after payday. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading AUTOMATE EVERYTHING, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
